title: a reference that does not resolve: a norn command or a repo path

explain.what: A doc or a string names a `norn` command or a repo path that does not exist.
explain.why: A broken reference sends the reader to a command that fails or a file that is not there. Docs go stale quietly this way.
explain.fix: Fix the name or the path. If the command or file was renamed, use the new name everywhere.
